name: @hl-bos/hscs-website
description: HSCS marketing website — Herman Supply Chain Solutions, Transportation & Operations Consulting. The public marketing site implementing the approved HSCS Commercial Launch Phase 1 Baseline (Commercial Foundation, Website IA, Homepage Architecture, Homepage Copy, Page Specifications, Design System). Delivers the Design System tokens in code, the shared header/nav/footer, the homepage, the services and industries pages, and the Operations Assessment intake -- the site's single primary conversion, which writes to the HL-BOS `intake` schema via a server action. Where no intake is configured the page renders no form and says why. No email and no analytics yet.
